references.text: The phrase "the world has gone after him" (ὁ κόσμος ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ) reflects Jesus' own prophecy in John 12:32 that he will draw all people to himself, but here viewed from the Pharisees' frustrated perspective.
The Pharisees' concern in John 11:48 that the whole world will go to ruin if they let Jesus continue is the direct premise for their conclusion in this verse that they achieve nothing.
The crowd's action in John 12:18, where they went out to meet Jesus, is the concrete event the Pharisees refer to when they say the world has gone after him.
